name: The Temple of the Moon
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
A once great creature of the forest is in need of help, friend.

There is a difficult task that must be done.

Please seek out Priestess A'moora; she will explain things to you. Find her to the southeast of here, inside the Temple of the Moon.
narrative.objectives: Sister Aquinne wants you to speak with Priestess A'moora in the Temple of the Moon.

chain.subtitle: 4 quests from level 10 to 12, 2,220 XP in all.

quests.name: The Sisterhood of Elune
quests.objectiveText: Speak to Sister Aquinne in Darnassus.

quests.name: The Temple of the Moon
quests.objectiveText: Sister Aquinne wants you to speak with Priestess A'moora in the Temple of the Moon.

quests.name: Tears of the Moon
quests.objectiveText: Priestess A'moora in the Temple of the Moon at Darnassus wants you to bring her Lady Sathrah's Silvery Spinnerets.

quests.name: Sathrah's Sacrifice
quests.objectiveText: Priestess A'moora wants you to place Lady Sathrah's silvery spinnerets at the fountain inside the temple, and then return to her.
